body.statement: For \(n_B,n_S\ge3\), \(\Phi_{n_B,n_S}(4)=2(n_B-1)(n_S-1)+2\), with unique paired multiset \(\{(n_B-1,n_S-1),(n_B-1,n_S-1),(1,1),(1,1)\}\) modulo block permutation.
body.justification: The lowest nondegenerate resolution is a transparent sanity check on the catalog and its equality accounting.
body.gap: This closed rectangular special case is not stated in the equal-block or general biclique papers.
body.consumer: An experiment requiring four assignments obtains an immediate design rule without catalog enumeration.
